_comment: Korax conformance fixture 11. THE MALFORMED-LOG CASE (#529). Six envelopes, and it differs from a well-formed log in EXACTLY ONE way: envelope 5 carries `pins -> 99`, an id this log does not contain. Every other record is fixture-04's own genesis, its canon-nest policy, and an ordinary pinned document, so a reader that mishandles this fixture is mishandling the dangling edge and not the scaffolding. The validator refuses a ref to an absent id at post time (1.1.7), so this state is unreachable by posting and reachable only by loading a log — a corrupted store, a partial restore, a second implementation with a weaker write path. Onboard must REPORT the gap (10.10) rather than drop the entry: a required document the log cannot resolve is still required, and silently shortening the canon set is the failure that section exists to forbid.
